description: This file contains PHP functions related to the rescheduling history of calls within the SuiteCRM environment. It defines methods to generate HTML for displaying call reschedule history and to count reschedules for a specific call, utilizing database queries and external class methods.

methods.name: reschedule_history
methods.description: Generates an HTML list of the reschedule history for a call in the DetailView context, fetching data from the database and formatting it using application strings.

methods.name: reschedule_count
methods.description: Counts the number of reschedules for a specific call and sets this value in the focus object.
